name: MemoryOS

construction.unit: dialogue page (query, response, timestamp, chain meta)
construction.kept_as: verbatim pages + LLM chain/segment summaries; LPM holds extracted traits/facts
construction.processing: LLM links page into dialogue chain and summarizes; pages grouped into topic segments

organization.structure: 3 tiers: STM queue, MTM segmented paging, LPM persona
organization.stores: STM (7 pages); MTM (<=200 segments); LPM user profile/KB/traits, agent profile/traits
organization.index: page/segment embeddings + LLM keyword sets (cosine + Jaccard); embedding model unnamed

management.operations: STM->MTM FIFO; heat-based segment eviction; heat > 5 promotes segment to LPM
management.forgetting: lowest-heat MTM segments evicted; User KB and Agent Traits FIFO at 100

retrieval.candidates: top-m=5 MTM segments by cosine + Jaccard keyword score
retrieval.selection: top-k pages by semantic similarity (k=10 LoCoMo, 5 GVD); LPM top-10 KB/traits
retrieval.budget: k=10 pages; ~3,874 recalled tokens on LoCoMo (Table 3)

use.context: all STM pages + retrieved MTM pages + LPM profile/traits/KB in one prompt

stages.ingestion: Each user query / model response pair with timestamp becomes a dialogue page in a fixed-length STM queue (length 7); an LLM decides chain linkage to prior pages and writes a chain summary (meta).
stages.construction: Pages evicted FIFO from STM are grouped into MTM topic segments when cosine(embedding) + Jaccard(LLM keywords) similarity exceeds theta=0.6; segment content is summarized by an LLM.
stages.organization: Three tiers: STM (dialogue pages), MTM (segmented paging, max 200 segments), LPM (user profile, User KB, 90-dimension User Traits, agent profile/traits).
stages.update: Segment heat = visits + page count + recency decay; lowest-heat segments are evicted, segments with heat > 5 are promoted to LPM where an LLM extracts user traits/KB facts (User KB and Agent Traits are FIFO queues of 100).
stages.retrieval: All STM pages; MTM two-stage: top-m=5 segments by the cosine+Jaccard score, then top-k pages (10 on LoCoMo) by semantic similarity; LPM: top-10 User KB and Agent Traits entries plus full profiles/traits.
stages.answer: Retrieved STM, MTM and LPM content is assembled into one prompt with the query for the LLM.

summary: OS-inspired three-tier memory (short-term pages, mid-term segment-paged topics, long-term persona) with FIFO and heat-based promotion/eviction between tiers.
notes:
AXES-CHECK: MTM segment selection is not pure vector similarity - it uses cosine similarity plus Jaccard overlap of LLM-extracted keywords (Eq. 3); page selection within segments is semantic similarity. The embedding model is not named in the paper. Venue: EMNLP 2025 main (aclanthology 2025.emnlp-main.1318).
DESIGN: Sec 3.1-3.5, 4.1 (implementation details), Table 3. Corrected prefill: 'heat-based promotion' moved from construction.processing to management.operations; retrieval is not pure vector (cosine + Jaccard of LLM keywords). conflicts=null: the paper describes no contradiction handling.
